title: Keep all descendant selectedcontent elements up to date
body: Previously only the first selectedcontent descendant of a select element was kept up to date. Removing it meant updating the next one from the removing steps, which mutates the tree while it is in an inconsistent state. Now every descendant selectedcontent element that is not disabled is kept up to date, and removing one has no effect on the others. Whether a selectedcontent element is disabled is now determined when it is inserted, so selectedcontent elements nested inside each other are never updated. As removing and moving steps cannot mutate the tree, the updates that result from removing or moving an option element, or from moving a selectedcontent element, happen in a microtask. Inserting a selected option element or a selectedcontent element still updates synchronously. In addition: * The select element's reset algorithm and the option element's selected setter now update selectedcontent elements. * Changing a select element's multiple or size attribute, an option or optgroup element's disabled attribute, or an option element's selected attribute now runs the selectedness setting algorithm and updates selectedcontent elements as needed. Removing the multiple attribute keeps the first selected option. * Removing an ancestor of a select element no longer disassociates its option elements from it. * HTMLSelectElement's selectedIndex and value, HTMLOptionsCollection's selectedIndex, and HTMLOptionElement's selected now have [CEReactions], as setting them can clone custom elements into selectedcontent elements. Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/57842, https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/58089, and https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/62242. Fixes #11880, fixes #11883, and fixes #12096. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium * WebKit - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/58089 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/57842 * https://wpt.fyi/results/html/semantics/forms/the-select-element/inserted-or-removed.html * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/62242 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: Already implemented * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2057581 * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=320187 - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: not needed - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: not needed because the existing mdn article doesn't mention anything about having multiple selectedcontent elements inside a select - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
